headline: The bins fill up and the cable remembers momentum
lede: PICK RUSH's line is alive now: every bin wears a tag-coloured fill meter that thunks and flashes its rim when a twelfth piece lands, and the hoist cable whips past its tilt on every gantry reversal before hanging straight. Pure render — twin-seed hashes prove the sim never felt it. Meanwhile the board's own honesty got fixed: two stale README gaps that kept kicking builders at done work are gone, and the picker aimed at real work again.

notes.text: PICK RUSH (#2678): per-bin fill columns climb 1/12, a full bin thunks once with a tag-coloured rim flash and the column wraps; the cable hangs on a light spring and overshoots the classic ±4 tilt (+5.8 px measured on the live centroid) when you slam the gantry the other way. gs.binFill and state hashes never see any of it.

pickcheck 49/49 Node + 24/24 Chrome: five new named gates (WHIP-SPRING/PIXELS/REST on real keyboard reversals, METER + METER-FULL on live paint). Two new mutants, vis and whip, reddened 3 and 2 gates by name; the carried-CAN pixel gate got the double-rAF painted-frame fix (#2136 family).

Stale gap accounting misdirects whole sessions: #2670 shipped its proof but never struck its README bullet, and #2223 half-struck a bullet that parseGaps then filtered as fully closed. Fixed in #2676/#2677/#2678 — strike what shipped, split what half-shipped, so idle-kick picks truth.

#1711 TARGET swept with fresh evidence: 14/14 store takes graded, nothing new since the last sweep; the ±50 ms clap line waits on one phone take from Jon (jonq #2652, deadline Nov 20 — default keeps waiting, nightly grader self-posts when it lands). Released to next without idling the lane.
